bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This rescue cat catch-up plan sequences doses against uri during intake, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your cat.

Milestone labels on the rescue cat catch-up table (Intake week; ~2–4 weeks later; Until protocol met; Clinic decision) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished rescue cat catch-up kitten series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with felv/fiv testing first or incomplete foster records, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the FVRCP catch-up booster so one reminder system owns the rescue cat catch-up week.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Call the clinic with product names and prior dates the day you notice a missed rescue cat catch-up dose; catch-up timing depends on age and gap length for this cat scenario.

Until the rescue cat catch-up series is current again, reduce the exposure pattern that matches uri during intake, and do not wait for an annual wellness slot to ask about a rescue cat catch-up make-up dose.
After the visit, enable 7-, 3-, and 1-day nudges for the next FVRCP catch-up booster due date so the same rescue cat catch-up miss cannot hide inside a shared family calendar.

faqs.question: Is this rescue cat vaccine catch-up a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual cat.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this rescue cat catch-up schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to uri during intake, and reset reminders as soon as the next rescue cat catch-up due date is known.

faqs.question: How do reminders help with FVRCP catch-up booster?
faqs.answer: PetClues can nudge you 7, 3, and 1 day before that rescue cat catch-up booster is due so boarding and travel deadlines stop arriving as surprises.
